```{r}
library(shiny)
library(randomForest)
library(fastshap)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r read_data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
churn <- read_csv(here('data/raw', 'Churn_Modelling.csv'))
head(churn)
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)

churn <- churn %>%
  mutate(Exited = factor(Exited))   # 0 = stayed, 1 = churned

train_index <- createDataPartition(churn$Exited, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)

train <- churn[train_index, ]
test  <- churn[-train_index, ]
```


## RG model with class weight to counter the imbalance 
```{r}
library(ranger)
class_weights <- c("0" = 1, "1" = 4)   # churners 4x weight
set.seed(123)

rf_w_model <- ranger(
  Exited ~ Geography + Gender + Age + Tenure +
    NumOfProducts + IsActiveMember + CreditScore + Balance,
  data       = train,
  num.trees      = 300,    # number of trees
  mtry       = 3,      # no. of variables tried at each split (sqrt of 8 ≈ 3)
  probability    = TRUE,
  class.weights  = class_weights
)

print(rf_w_model)

dir.create("/Users/stevemathew/stevemac-portfolio/projects/uk-energy-churn/model", 
           showWarnings = FALSE)

saveRDS(rf_w_model, "/Users/stevemathew/stevemac-portfolio/projects/uk-energy-churn/model/rf_model.rds")
```


```{r}
rf_w_probs <- predict(rf_w_model, data = test)$predictions[, "1"]

rf_w_pred_03 <- ifelse(rf_w_probs >= 0.3, "1", "0")
rf_w_pred_03 <- factor(rf_w_pred_03, levels = c("0", "1"))

rf_w_cm_03 <- confusionMatrix(rf_w_pred_03, test$Exited, positive = "1")
rf_w_cm_03
rf_w_cm_03$byClass[c("Recall", "Precision")]
```


```{r}
file.create("/Users/stevemathew/stevemac-portfolio/projects/uk-energy-churn/app.R")
library(shiny)
library(ranger)
library(fastshap)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)

rf_model <- readRDS("/Users/stevemathew/stevemac-portfolio/projects/uk-energy-churn/model/rf_model.rds")

# after loading rf_model, add this
background <- train[sample(nrow(train), 100), 
                    c("Geography", "Gender", "Age", "Tenure", 
                      "NumOfProducts", "IsActiveMember", "CreditScore", "Balance")]

pfun <- function(object, newdata) {
  as.numeric(predict(object, data = newdata)$predictions[, "1"])
}

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Customer Churn Risk — UK Energy"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      h4("Customer Profile"),
      selectInput("Geography", "Geography", choices = c("France", "Germany", "Spain")),
      selectInput("Gender", "Gender", choices = c("Male", "Female")),
      sliderInput("Age", "Age", min = 18, max = 92, value = 40),
      sliderInput("Tenure", "Tenure (years)", min = 0, max = 10, value = 5),
      sliderInput("NumOfProducts", "Number of Products", min = 1, max = 4, value = 1),
      selectInput("IsActiveMember", "Active Member", choices = c("Yes" = 1, "No" = 0)),
      sliderInput("CreditScore", "Credit Score", min = 300, max = 850, value = 600),
      numericInput("Balance", "Balance (£)", value = 50000, min = 0, max = 250000),
      actionButton("predict_btn", "Calculate Risk", class = "btn-primary")
    ),
    mainPanel(
      h4("Churn Probability"),
      uiOutput("risk_box"),
      hr(),
      h4("Why this prediction?"),
      plotOutput("shap_plot", height = "400px")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  result <- eventReactive(input$predict_btn, {
    customer <- data.frame(
      Geography      = input$Geography,
      Gender         = input$Gender,
      Age            = as.numeric(input$Age),
      Tenure         = as.numeric(input$Tenure),
      NumOfProducts  = as.numeric(input$NumOfProducts),
      IsActiveMember = as.numeric(input$IsActiveMember),
      CreditScore    = as.numeric(input$CreditScore),
      Balance        = as.numeric(input$Balance)
    )
    prob <- predict(rf_model, data = customer)$predictions[, "1"]
    shap_vals <- fastshap::explain(
      rf_model,
      X            = background,
      newdata      = customer,
      pred_wrapper = pfun,
      nsim         = 100
  )
    list(prob = prob, shap = shap_vals)
  })

  output$risk_box <- renderUI({
    req(result())
    prob <- round(result()$prob * 100, 1)
    color <- if (prob >= 60) "#c0392b" else if (prob >= 35) "#e67e22" else "#27ae60"
    div(
      style = paste0("font-size: 48px; font-weight: bold; color: ", color, "; padding: 20px 0;"),
      paste0(prob, "%"),
      div(style = "font-size: 16px; color: #666; font-weight: normal;",
          if (prob >= 60) "High risk — consider immediate outreach"
          else if (prob >= 35) "Medium risk — monitor closely"
          else "Low risk — customer likely to stay")
    )
  })

  output$shap_plot <- renderPlot({
    req(result())
    shap_df <- as.data.frame(result()$shap) %>%
      pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Feature", values_to = "SHAP") %>%
      arrange(desc(abs(SHAP)))

    ggplot(shap_df, aes(x = reorder(Feature, SHAP), y = SHAP, fill = SHAP > 0)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.6) +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c("TRUE" = "#e74c3c", "FALSE" = "#3498db"),
        labels = c("TRUE" = "Increases churn risk", "FALSE" = "Decreases churn risk")
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
      labs(x = "Feature", y = "SHAP Value", fill = "") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
        legend.position = "bottom"
      )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
